restrictions: The two messages have 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^32: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block. The last chunk is compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t, v13 = 0), flags 3 and its true block length; the 63-byte block ends in eight zero bytes, so words 14 and 15 and the top byte of word 13 are zero in both zero-filled blocks. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests by the tree lemma of proof.md Section 7.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision between two distinct complete messages.

Exact part: for every trial of proof.md Section 8 the two last-chunk chaining values agree on words 0, 2, 5 and 7; E1.c1 lies in the union U (2^22 words) of the cube of beta* = 18b0e098 (c1 AND 0e09818b = 02008000) and the cube of beta3 = 18d0e098 (c1 AND 0e09818d = 02008001), and each trial's beta is that of its cube; Y4 ranges over the whole class of eta (524,288 values; no sub-class, no rule on h1), and t is solved per trial; trials with t = 0 are skipped. Only outer steps that pass the exact widened filter of proof.md 9.8 for the nine listed outcomes S9 (S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0 of beta* at eps 6e21be55, and {185,285,385}020a0 of beta3 at eps 6e61be55; share 23,384,160,813,285,376 / 2^64 = 2^-9.6236) are searched further; by Lemmas F9, VP, G7, G15, G7b, G15b, G20b, RC, CV and CV9 none loses a counted success. Other outcomes are not counted. Heuristic part: a search over 2^90.945 walked trials (2^68.945 outer steps of 2^22) succeeds with probability at least 0.39 under H1' and H4'.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, 430 machine units (operations, loads, stores) per unit, on a 64-register load/store machine with immediate constants; each fetch of a memory word costs one load. Outer steps run seven to a batch in lean packed 36-bit lanes: 341 units per batch, 13 per lane whose test-(2) mask is not zero, 512 per passing lane, and the cap 314,996,576 for steps 2 and 3 of every passing outer step (17,504 for the joint solver of proof.md 9.4 with (G7), (G15) and Lemma RC on S; 157,489,536 for each of at most two rows of beta3 in the guarded generic solver of 9.8): proved upper allowances, not counts. The filter is read from two direct 2^32-entry tables (2^38 bytes, built once for 2^51 units). No sorting, no lookup by value, no table that grows with the trials. The run halts with failure when the test-(2) count or the pass count exceeds its budget, or after RUN_BATCHES batches; each row is charged at its budget plus one (proof.md Sections 9, 11).

Randomized by eight fresh uniform 256-bit words per batch of seven outer steps; each outer step reads its own disjoint bits (proof.md Lemma PL). Success 0.39 holds only under heuristics H1' and H4'. The factor 70,943,656,228 in H1' is five sevenths of the model's conditional count of the nine listed outcomes on U, rounded down; the three parts of beta3 are GPT Sol's exact counts from the participant's integer records, and no rate of beta3 was measured. The filter, the pre-check, the guards and the certificates are exact; the filter shares enter only the budgets (H4'). The submitted program runs this search at toy scale on the root instance (counter 0, flags 11), reading the masks from the automata of the filter: no digest experiment can show a half-collision of a non-root chunk's chaining value. No full 2-round collision is exhibited. A distinct path filed to record it, not our best score.

Six 32-bit constants, eta, the beta* cube, the seven tau values and eps of the filter, the mask of S, and beta3 with its cube, its eps and the byte of its three outcomes are the advice record (90 bytes, proof.md Section 12). The constants were found by a participant's solver search and chosen by one exact count per model; beta* is the beta of that solution, S is the six-outcome set of least charge in entry 0bc5f130, and the three outcomes of beta3 are fixed by proof.md 9.8. preprocessing_log2 55 bounds the selection procedure SEL of proof.md Section 12 (below 2^62.946 operations, 2^54.198 units) in full, by construction, and it is included in time_log2; that SEL returns these values rests on the participant's records. memory_log2_bytes 44 covers the two output messages (each below 2^42 bytes), the code, the direct tables, selection and search, held at once. No priority or novelty claim.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. H1' of proof.md 10.3, restated for the union (GPT Sol, answer AX 2.4). Over the run's RUN_STEPS = 568,084,180,184,553,153,661 independent uniform 256-bit words, let N_o be the number of listed good valid trials of one outer step: c1 in U, the union of the cube Q* of beta* = 18b0e098 and the cube Q3 of beta3 = 18d0e098 (2^22 words), t != 0, R = 0, and an E1 outcome in S9 (S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0 of beta* at eps 6e21be55, and {185,285,385}020a0 of beta3 at eps 6e61be55); Y4 in the whole class of eta; no rule on h1; counted over all of U whether or not the outer step passes the widened filter or the pre-check. (i) E[N_o] >= (2^22 - 1) q with q = FACTOR * 2^-128, FACTOR = floor(5 * 2^10 * 96,993,280 / 7) = 70,943,656,228, about 2^-91.954 (just under five sevenths of the conditional model rate p9 = 99,321,118,720 * 2^-128 of the nine outcomes on U). (ii) No hit and dependence: the probability that no valid trial of the run is a listed good trial is at most exp(-0.49676) + 0.001. Given (i), rho = E[N_o(N_o-1)]/E[N_o] <= 0.0065 is sufficient for (ii) by Lemma S8. Neither the reviewed premise of entry 26ebba63 (sub-class, rule A, seven outcomes) nor the H1' of entry 0bc5f130 (S on Q*) implies this law, which includes three outcomes of another beta on another cube; it is declared here anew. By Lemmas F9, VP, G7, G15, G7b, G15b, G20b and CV9 the widened filter, the pre-check and the guards skip no listed good trial, so N_o is the same count, pointwise.
heuristics.scope: Exactly the trials of proof.md Sections 8 and 9 with 9.8: lengths 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 with a non-root last chunk (counter t, v13 = 0, flags 3), the six constants of Section 3.2, Y4 a member of the whole class of eta (524,288 values, Lemma Q) drawn with the outer words from the run's fresh 256-bit words (seven outer steps to a batch, each on its own disjoint bits, Lemma PL), E1.c1 ranging over the union U of the cubes of beta* and beta3 (2^22 words; every c1 is reached through exactly one E3.h1, 9.8), t solved per trial and t = 0 skipped. Only outer steps that pass the widened filter of 9.8 are searched further; N_o counts all of U in every outer step and only the nine outcomes of S9.
heuristics.extrapolation: From exact integer counts under the seven-word model of Section 10 with Y4 uniform in the class: the part of the six outcomes of S, 67,633,152 on the per-trial scale 2^-83 (the participant's counting program and its six rows, printed in Section 17), and GPT Sol's exact parts of the three outcomes of beta3, 12,582,912 (285020a0), 8,388,608 (385020a0) and 8,388,608 (185020a0), from the participant's integer L and N3 records under the same normalization (answer AX 2.3); together 96,993,280, times 2^10 for drawing c1 from U (Lemma S1 applied to each cube), taken at five sevenths, rounded down. Participant evidence of Section 13, untrusted by the harness, bears on beta* only: a whole-class graphics-card run of 2^46 real counter trials in which the E1 rate of the seven outcomes of entry 59f8915e is 1.0020 +- 0.0086 of the model (13,595 events); 2^43 real trials inside passing outer steps of the seven-outcome filter on the sub-class, listed E1 outcome 0.979 +- 0.022 of its value; and a reduced-width (8-bit) end-to-end run of complete messages in which the counter arrangement found 251 collisions against 255.0 predicted. No rate was measured for beta3, its cube or its three outcomes, and the joint 128-bit event, about 2^-91 per trial, is not measured.
heuristics.limitations: The factor 70,943,656,228 is assumed. The three parts of beta3 are GPT Sol's counts from the participant's records; this package does not reprint or recount them, and no experiment measures a rate of beta3. The reviewed premise of entry 26ebba63 and the premise of entry 0bc5f130 are not inherited. The transfer of the single-trial law to the actual sampler is partly proved for Q* (Lemmas S1-S5, S8, S9, VP, G7, G15), only algebraically for Q3 (reachability and Lemmas F9, V9, G7b, G15b, G20b, CV9), and otherwise assumed in (i); the dependence condition of (ii) is assumed. The organizer-run experiment runs the search on the root instance (counter 0, flags 11) and measures neither the factor nor the counter half-collision. The time bound charges the guarded generic solver at its full static trees in every passing outer step: an upper schedule, not a recommended configuration.

heuristics.statement: Supporting. H4' of proof.md 10.3: the union count-budget clause for the widened E and pass indicators (GPT Sol, answer AX 2.4). With probability at least 0.9995 over the coins both clauses hold, so no budget halts the run. (a) Pass budget: at most PASS_BUDGET = 765,144,922,463,168,754 outer steps pass the widened filter for S9 (nominal share pi9 = 23,384,160,813,285,376 / 2^64 = 2^-9.6236). (b) Lean test-(2) budget: at most E_BUDGET = 42,876,990,928,602,462,880 lanes have a nonzero test-(2) mask for S9 and run the Q path (nominal share 305,100,224 / 2^32 = 2^-3.8153). Each budget is ceil(17/16 * RUN_STEPS * share). Reaching a budget halts with failure; the time bound charges each budget plus one. There is no solver budget: every passing outer step is charged the cap of steps 2 and 3.
heuristics.scope: The counts N_E and N_2 of proof.md 10.3 over the RUN_STEPS outer steps of step 1 of Section 9.1, with Y4 drawn from the whole class: each is binomial over independent outer steps (Lemma PL) with the sampler's probability of its indicator; the two indicators of one outer step may depend on each other in any way.
heuristics.extrapolation: The nominal shares are exact for uniform independent (Y9, omega): GPT Sol's finite 32-layer carry-set count over the nine outcomes (answer AX 2.3; 11 mask cells for (1), 41 for (2)), whose recount of the six outcomes of S alone reproduces the share 279,070,422,111 / 2^48 of Section 8. If each sampler probability is at most 1.06 times its nominal share, the Chernoff bound puts each overflow below exp(-RUN_STEPS * share * 53 / 18,020,000): exp(-1.1 * 10^14) and exp(-2.1 * 10^12), so their union is far below 0.0005. Measured only for the six-outcome filter of S (Section 13, untrusted by the harness, Python's generator, whole class, 60,000,000 real outer steps): test (2) 1.0004 +- 0.0005 and pass 0.9980 +- 0.0041 of their nominal values. The widened filter of this package was not measured on the sampler; its two counts are recounted exactly from the program's own automata by the self-test of proof.md 9.3.
heuristics.limitations: That each sampler probability is at most 1.06 times its nominal share is not proved: the sampler's Y9 and omega are not proved independent and uniform, and the widened shares were not measured at all. The time bound and the filter do not depend on these shares.
